inputs.text: Powerful governments are driving this crisis, while civilians with the least ability to flee or recover are made to bear the cost. Threats to civilian areas and essential infrastructure put people’s access to vital services at risk; that is not an acceptable side effect of political decisions. Claims of a “just war” mean little without accountability and meaningful protection for civilians. We should reject the idea that wider regional war is inevitable and demand de-escalation and protection for those most at risk.
